en.headline: Light goods van overturns after late-night crash with taxi in Sha Tin
en.dek: A light goods vehicle and a taxi collided at Tai Chung Kiu Road shortly after 11 p.m. on Thursday. Both drivers were injured and taken to Prince of Wales Hospital.
body: A light goods vehicle overturned after colliding with a taxi at the junction of Tai Chung Kiu Road and Sha Tin Rural Committee Road at about 11.18 p.m. on Thursday, according to police and multiple local reports.

Passing drivers called for help, fearing the van driver was trapped. Officers and firefighters found that the van driver, a man in his fifties, had already climbed out. He and the taxi driver, a man in his late fifties, were treated for injuries including to the hands and neck and were taken to Prince of Wales Hospital.
Photographs circulating online showed the taxi with a crumpled front and the van lying on its side across the junction. Police said they were investigating the cause of the collision.

zh.headline: 沙田大涌橋路貨Van撞的士後翻側 兩司機受傷
zh.dek: 周四晚約11時18分，輕型貨車與的士在大涌橋路交界相撞，貨車翻側，兩名司機受傷送往威爾斯親王醫院。
body: 據警方及多家本地傳媒報道，周四晚上約11時18分，一輛輕型貨車與一輛的士在沙田大涌橋路與沙田鄉事會路交界相撞，其後貨車翻側橫亘路口。
途經司機擔心貨車司機被困而報案。警員及消防到場時，五十多歲的貨車男司機已自行爬出車外。他與五十多歲的的士男司機分別手部及頸部受傷，經治理後由救護車送往威爾斯親王醫院。
網上圖片顯示的士車頭損毀，貨車向右側翻。警方正調查意外原因。
